description: This file defines the class SugarLoggerHandler which integrates Monolog's logging with the SuiteCRM LoggerManager by extending AbstractProcessingHandler. It converts Monolog log levels to SuiteCRM log levels and writes log messages accordingly.

classes.name: SugarLoggerHandler
classes.description: A class that extends Monolog's AbstractProcessingHandler to route logs through SuiteCRM's LoggerManager, translating log levels and handling log records.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Handles writing a log record to the SuiteCRM logger, converting the Monolog record's level to SuiteCRM's level and logging the message.

methods.name: psrToSugarLevel
methods.description: Converts a Monolog log level (integer) into a string level recognized by SuiteCRM's LoggerManager.
